name: tilde-latex
description: Tilde · LaTeX editor. Keeps your work together, like Fig.~3.

scripts.predev: node -e "if (+process.versions.node.split('.')[0] < 22) { console.error('Tilde needs Node.js 22.12 or newer; this is ' + process.version + '. With nvm: nvm use'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.download-engine: texlyre-busytex download-assets public/core && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const dir = 'public/core/busytex'; for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) if (/^texlive-(recommended|extra)/.test(f)) fs.rmSync(dir + '/' + f)"
